enum Activation
  ON_DEMAND = 'on_demand'
  ATTACH = 'attach'
  REMOTE = 'remote'
enum ApplicationActivationOutcome
  READY = 'ready'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  DISABLED = 'disabled'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  LAUNCH_REFUSED = 'launch_refused'
  IDENTITY_REFUSED = 'identity_refused'
  NOT_READY = 'not_ready'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ApplicationActivationRecipe
  arguments: list[str]
  readiness: ApplicationInterface
  readiness_timeout_ms: int
dataclass ApplicationActivationResult
  outcome: ApplicationActivationOutcome | None
  instance: str
  started: bool
  reason: str

  outcome: ApplicationOutcome | None
  instance: str
  reason: str

  name: str
  title: str
  revision: str

  name: str
  program: str
  title: str
  start_guidance: str
  activation: ApplicationActivationRecipe | None

  instances: list[ApplicationInstance]
  scope: Scope | None
  self_registered: bool
dataclass ApplicationInstance
  instance: str
  interfaces: list[ApplicationInterface]
  contexts: list[ApplicationContext]
  expires_unix_ms: int
dataclass ApplicationInterface
  name: str
  protocol: str
  contract: str
enum ApplicationOutcome
  APPLIED = 'applied'
  PAGE = 'page'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  STALE = 'stale'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
dataclass ApplicationPage

  cursor: str

dataclass ApplicationPresence

  instance: str

  contexts: list[ApplicationContext]

dataclass ApplicationStart

  title: str
  started_unix_ms: int
  launched: bool
dataclass ApplicationStartPage
  outcome: ApplicationOutcome | None
  starts: list[ApplicationStart]
  cursor: str
  complete: bool
  complete_since_unix_ms: int
class Applications
  register(descriptor: ApplicationDescriptor) -> ApplicationChange
  ask_confirmation(application: str) -> ApplicationChange
  remove(application: str) -> ApplicationChange
  announce(presence: ApplicationPresence) -> ApplicationChange
  withdraw(application: str, instance: str) -> ApplicationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ApplicationPage
  activate(application: str) -> ApplicationActivationResult
  list_starts(cursor: str, limit: int) -> ApplicationStartPage
class ApplicationsClient(Applications)
  __init__(transport)
  register(descriptor: ApplicationDescriptor) -> ApplicationChange
  ask_confirmation(application: str) -> ApplicationChange
  remove(application: str) -> ApplicationChange
  announce(presence: ApplicationPresence) -> ApplicationChange
  withdraw(application: str, instance: str) -> ApplicationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> ApplicationPage
  activate(application: str) -> ApplicationActivationResult
  list_starts(cursor: str, limit: int) -> ApplicationStartPage

class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class Registry
  declarations() -> DeclarationList
  declare(expected_revision: str, declaration: Declaration) -> DeclarationChange
  withdraw(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> DeclarationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> DeclarationObservation
class RegistryClient(Registry)
  __init__(transport)
  declarations() -> DeclarationList
  declare(expected_revision: str, declaration: Declaration) -> DeclarationChange
  withdraw(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> DeclarationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> DeclarationObservation
class RegistryV2
  declarations() -> DeclarationListV2
  declare(expected_revision: str, declaration: DeclarationWithExtensions) -> DeclarationChange
  withdraw(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> DeclarationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> DeclarationObservationV2
  declarations_pinned() -> PinnedDeclarationList
  declare_pinned(expected_revision: str, declaration: PinnedDeclaration) -> DeclarationChange
  replace_pinned(expected_revision: str, declaration: PinnedDeclaration) -> DeclarationChange
  observe_pinned(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> PinnedDeclarationObservation
class RegistryV2Client(RegistryV2)
  __init__(transport)
  declarations() -> DeclarationListV2
  declare(expected_revision: str, declaration: DeclarationWithExtensions) -> DeclarationChange
  withdraw(expected_revision: str, name: str) -> DeclarationChange
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> DeclarationObservationV2
  declarations_pinned() -> PinnedDeclarationList
  declare_pinned(expected_revision: str, declaration: PinnedDeclaration) -> DeclarationChange
  replace_pinned(expected_revision: str, declaration: PinnedDeclaration) -> DeclarationChange
  observe_pinned(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> PinnedDeclarationObservation

  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
